limits: operator new is a physical allocation fixture; its implementation is not recovered.
operator delete is a physical release fixture; its implementation is not recovered.
realloc is scripted at the CRT boundary and must preserve copied bytes and allocation lifetime.
lstrlenA is a scripted Windows string-length service reached by unchanged original CString assignment.
InterlockedDecrement is a scripted Windows reference-count service reached by unchanged original CString release.
The diagnostic saved-EBP and return-PC accessors execute unchanged original code through explicit compiler contexts.
Ownership covers only the 11 registration wrappers; stored callback and constructor identities do not establish actor behavior.
notes: Boundary reviewed against every original entry. All wrappers are cdecl with zero arguments and no meaningful return. Reuse the existing registry-core registerBinding bridge, retaining literal comparison branches, binding order and per-site diagnostic continuation PCs.
